messages:
Ant: Quick follow-up to the lease allocator RFC: saw a rollback race in staging where eviction overlapped a lease renewal. Small-batch workload, non-deterministic but reproducible under load.
Sel: Saw similar. Can you drop logs?
Ant: logs:
```
[evict] lease=891 renew@1765112221 -> rollback
[kv] free-slot still referenced
[compact] removed slot id=7
```
Sel: Looks like renew ack didn't reach compactor before reclaim.
Jia: Current flow is allocate -> persist lease -> async notify compactor/evictor. If notify delayed, compactor can act on stale state.
Tom: Options: (1) make persist+notify sync (adds latency), (2) add monotonic lease-gen with CAS so evict checks gen, (3) compactor consults authoritative lease table before reclaim (extra RPC).
Ant: Prefer (2): keep common path low-latency, fail-safe via CAS. Renew bumps gen, evict compares expected gen.
Sel: Need linearizability or CAS on our metadata store. Otherwise writes can reorder.
Jia: Dedicated/private kvs support CAS; hosted needs a shim. Tradeoff: extra metadata ops vs correctness. We can tolerate some spurious compactor aborts with backoff.
Tom: I'll prototype gen+CAS in allocator branch and add microbench for renew+evict contention.
Ant: Add telemetry: lease_reclaim_abort, lease_cas_fail, lease_double_ref_detect. Ops-bot: feature-flag lease_metrics_v1 ON in staging.
Sel: I'll add race-injection unit test that delays renew ack.
Jia: I'll audit providers for CAS and open an issue linking RFC #421 with perf targets: p99 latency increase <1ms, abort <0.1% under normal load.
Ant: Also consider batching gen increments per tenant to reduce QPS; note ordering requirements. Keep synchronous persist as fallback if CAS path noisy.
Tom: Action items: Tom -> prototype + bench; Sel -> telemetry + tests; Jia -> provider audit + issue; Ant -> update RFC and metrics. Check-in Friday.
Ant: Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
thread_summary: Staging rollback race between eviction and lease-renew. Team opts to prototype monotonic lease-gen with CAS to avoid reclaiming active slots; will add telemetry, tests, and audit metadata providers. Actions assigned.
